description:
BLOCKED on the six-equation solver existing. Placeholder test already landed: multiphase_1d::edwards_tests::two_fluid_step_still_refuses_to_pretend pins the documented contract that TwoFluid1d::step() returns NotYetImplemented, and its doc comment describes the Edwards case to write once the solver exists.

Test-ownership split (maintainer instruction, 2026-08-11): tampines-steam-tables tests own the HEM models; tampines tests own drift flux and the six-equation model.

Landed on 2026-08-11 in crates/tampines/src/multiphase_1d/edwards_tests.rs:
- edwards_drift_flux_gs1_pressure_history (ACTIVE gate, 36-39 s): full 600 ms Edwards-O'Brien blowdown on DriftFlux1d, 24 cells, dt = 30 us, Hendrie non-isothermal IC, HEM-choked break through 0.87 A with the 1 ms rupture-disc ramp. Measured: GS-1 pressure RMSE 29.0 psia vs the digitised Edwards curve over 16 points (0-0.30 s), worst +52.0 psia at t = 0.100 s, flashing plateau 354.3 psia (experimental band ~350-367), break peak 101.0 lbm/s, 99.7 % drained, no cold tail (min 372.6 K) and +0.0 psia rebound.
- edwards_drift_flux_slip_and_tau_sensitivity (#[ignore], 132 s) and edwards_drift_flux_explore (#[ignore] scratch runner).

Key finding for the future six-equation case: turning the slip closure off entirely (C0 = 1, Vgj = 0) changes GS-1 pressure by at most 1.44 psia even though peak |v_g - v_l| goes 57.6 m/s -> 0. Edwards-O'Brien GS-1 pressure is therefore a poor discriminator of MECHANICAL non-equilibrium; a six-equation Edwards case should be judged on whether THERMAL non-equilibrium (max_thermal_nonequilibrium) changes anything, not on pressure RMSE alone. Mesh refinement (48 cells) moves GS-1 more (6.89 psia) than any model parameter does.

DoD: once TwoFluid1d::step() computes, write the Edwards two-fluid case in edwards_tests.rs mirroring run_edwards(), report max_thermal_nonequilibrium alongside the GS-1 pressure comparison, and record methodology + measured results per the workspace V&V doc rule.
title: tampines: Edwards-O'Brien two-fluid (6-eqn) test -- blocked until op-dt3.13/op-dt3.19 deliver the solver
